pois.name: Senso-ji Temple
pois.description: Walk through the iconic Kaminarimon Gate into Tokyo's oldest and most sacred Buddhist temple. Explore vibrant Nakamise shopping stalls, traditional incense burners, and magnificent five-story pagodas.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Best visited in the morning before crowds arrive
✓ Free historic attraction within your budget
✓ Only 400m from your breakfast spot
✓ 4.7★ reviews with iconic architecture
pois.tip: Visit before 9:00 AM to enjoy peaceful photo opportunities before large tour groups arrive.

pois.name: Tokyo Skytree
pois.description: Ascend 350 meters above ground to panoramic glass observation decks featuring 360-degree views of Mount Fuji and the expansive Tokyo skyline.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Iconic 360-degree panoramic skyline views
✓ Fits JPY 2,100 ticket budget
✓ High photo spot rating
✓ Direct metro connection from Asakusa
pois.tip: Pre-book tickets online to skip the main entrance line during peak afternoon hours.

pois.name: Ichiran Ramen Asakusa
pois.description: Savor world-famous tonkotsu ramen served in private solo dining booths customized with your choice of noodle firmness, broth richness, and spicy red sauce.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Only 350m walk from Senso-ji Temple
✓ Fits lunch timing (12:00 PM)
✓ High rating for authentic Japanese ramen
✓ Budget-friendly meal
pois.tip: Use the ticket vending machine at the entrance to select your meal before taking a booth seat.
pois.signature_dish: Classic Tonkotsu Ramen with Secret Spicy Red Sauce

pois.name: Tokyo National Museum
pois.description: Explore Japan's oldest and largest art museum, holding comprehensive collections of ancient samurai armor, national treasure kimonos, and Buddhist statues.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Premier cultural institution in Ueno Park
✓ Air-conditioned indoor gallery ideal for afternoon
✓ Matches cultural interest
✓ 4.6★ reviews
pois.tip: Check the Japanese Gallery (Honkan) first for samurai swords and ancient pottery.
nearby: National Museum of Nature and Science

pois.name: Shibuya Sky
pois.description: Stand on an open-air rooftop sky deck 229 meters above Shibuya Crossing, offering stunning unobstructed sunset views of Tokyo and Mount Fuji.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Top-rated sunset spot (4.8★)
✓ Panoramic open-air glass rooftop
✓ Excellent photography opportunities
✓ Direct elevator from Shibuya Station
pois.tip: Book sunset time slots at least 2 weeks in advance as golden hour tickets sell out fast.
